method: Offline replay of the two supplied prompt inputs with current profiles.json. Rule text matched to frozen snapshot metadata where possible; unmatched scopes/fields reconstructed from literal catalog names in the text. No live model, database, embeddings or trace export.
limitations: Prompt-size comparison only; reconstructed metadata may differ from the VM. Estimates use cl100k_base, not the Qwen tokenizer, and exclude chat framing, structured-output schema, reasoning and generated tokens.
